hosting: romUrl values are same-repo relative paths (relative to classic/atari2600/index.html); remote URLs can be dropped in later with no code changes.

games.title: PONG
games.desc: Pong for the Atari 2600 by Alessandro Miertschink (miertink), written from scratch in 6502 assembly against the bare TIA/RIOT hardware. Two-player paddle classic.

games.title: CYLOID
games.desc: A tank shooter for the Atari 2600 by Keith Adler, hand-written in 6502 assembly. A tight 4KB cart of armored duel action.

games.title: PIPES-2600
games.desc: Atari 2600 homebrew by Alexandre Luiz Brisighello Filho (albf), inspired by Pipe Mania and built with batari Basic. Rotate pipes to keep the flow going.
